import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String s = br.readLine().trim();
        // Replace 'dot' with '.' in the middle of the string
        s = s.substring(0, 1) + s.substring(1, s.length() - 1).replace("dot", ".") + s.substring(s.length() - 1);

        System.out.println(s);
